locations.note: An expedition at this Ashanti crater lake reports an unknown lifeform, and Sam investigates.
The story opens with journalist Sam Peters escaping an island off Bali.
Sam's home base, where her editor hands her the Ghana assignment.
Sam meets Professor Hartmann at Humboldt University's biological institute.

routes.name: Sam Peters
routes.note: Escaping the burning island off Bali, Sam reports home to Hamburg, chases Professor Hartmann from Berlin to the crater lake of Bosumtwi and the caves of the Asanbosam.
